questions.stem:
What volume of hydrogen gas at STP would be liberated by action of $50\ \mathrm{mL}$ of $\mathrm{H_2SO_4}$ of $50\%$ purity (density $= 1.3\ \mathrm{g\,mL^{-1}}$) on $20\ \mathrm{g}$ of zinc ?
Given : Molar mass of H, O, S, Zn are 1, 16, 32, $65\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$ respectively.
questions.solution:
$w_{\mathrm{H_2SO_4}} = 50 \times 1.3 = 65\ \mathrm{g}$
$\mathrm{Zn + H_2SO_4 \longrightarrow ZnSO_4 + H_2}$
$\frac{20}{65} \qquad \frac{65}{98} \times \frac{1}{2}$
$0.307 = 0.331 \qquad\qquad \downarrow\ 0.307$ mole
$V_{\mathrm{H_2}} = 0.307 \times 22.4\ \mathrm{L} = 6.892\ \mathrm{L}$

questions.stem:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are true ?
A. If two orbitals have the same value of $(n + l)$, the orbital with lower value of $n$ will have lower energy.
B. Energies of the orbitals in the same subshell increase with increase in atomic number.
C. The size of $2p_{x}$ orbital is less than the size of $3p_{x}$ orbital.
D. Among 5f, 6s, 4d, 5p and 5d orbitals, none of the orbitals have 2 radial nodes.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
A. for same value of $(n + l)$
$n \uparrow \quad E \uparrow$
B. Energies of the orbitals in the same subshell decreases with increase in atomic no.
C. $n \uparrow$ size of orbital $\uparrow$
D. 5d orbital has 2 radial nodes.

questions.stem:
Consider the following data for the reaction
$$\mathrm{X_2(g) + Y_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2XY(g)}$$
at $600\ \mathrm{K}$. The $\Delta_{r}G^{\ominus}$ (in $\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$) for the reaction is :
Compound | $\Delta_{f}H^{\ominus}_{600\mathrm{K}}$ ($\mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$) | $S^{\ominus}_{600\mathrm{K}}$ ($\mathrm{J\,mol^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$)
$\mathrm{XY(g)}$ | 42 | 200
$\mathrm{X_2(g)}$ | 8 | 140
$\mathrm{Y_2(g)}$ | 80 | 250
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{X_2(g) + Y_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2XY(g)}$
$\Delta_{r}H = [2 \times (42)] - [80 - 18] = -4\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$
$\Delta_{r}S = [2 \times 200] - [140 + 250] = 10\ \mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$
$\Delta_{r}S = \Delta_{r}H - T\Delta_{r}S$
$= -4000 - 600\,(10)$
$= -10000\ \mathrm{J\,mol^{-1}}$
$= -10\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$

questions.stem: The correct order of molar heat capacities measured at $298\mathrm{K}$ and $1\ \mathrm{bar}$ is :
questions.solution:
Generally, molar heat capacity of liquids is greater than solids because liquids have greater DOF and thus can store mole energy with lesser temperature rise. Also, for monoatomic gases, Cm is low as only translational DOF is present.
$C_m : \mathrm{Br_2(\ell) > Cu(s) > He(g)}$

questions.stem:
The reaction $\mathrm{A(g) \rightleftharpoons B(g) + C(g)}$ was initiated with the amount 'a' of $\mathrm{A(g)}$. At equilibrium it is found that the amount of $\mathrm{A(g)}$ remaining is $(a - x)$ at a total pressure of $p$.
The equilibrium constant $K_p$ of the reaction can be calculated from the expression :
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{A(g) \rightleftharpoons B(g) + C(g)}$
$t = 0$ | $a$ | | 
$t = t_{eq}$ | $a - x$ | $x$ | $x$ | $\sum n_{eq} = a + x$
p.p. | $\frac{a - x}{a + x}.p$ | $\frac{x}{a + x}.p$ | $\frac{x}{a + x}.p$
$K_p = \dfrac{\frac{x^{2}}{(a + x)^{2}}p^{2}}{\frac{a - x}{a + x}.p} = \frac{x^{2}}{a^{2} - x^{2}}.p$

questions.stem:
One half cell in a voltaic cell is constructed by dipping silver rod in $\mathrm{AgNO_3}$ solution of unknown concentration, other half cell is Zn rod dipped in 1 molar solution of $\mathrm{ZnSO_4}$.
A voltage of $1.60\ \mathrm{V}$ is measured at $298\ \mathrm{K}$ for this cell. What is the concentration of $\mathrm{Ag^{+}}$ ions used in terms of $\log x\ (x = [\mathrm{Ag^{+}}])$ ?
$E^{\ominus}_{\mathrm{Zn^{2+}/Zn}} = -0.76\mathrm{V},\ E^{\ominus}_{\mathrm{Ag^{+}/Ag}} = +0.80\mathrm{V},\ \frac{2.303RT}{F} = 0.059\mathrm{V}$
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{Zn(s) + 2Ag^{+}(aq) \rightarrow Zn^{+2}(aq) + 2Ag(s)}$
$E_{cell} = E^{\circ}_{cell} - \frac{0.059}{2}\log\frac{[\mathrm{Zn^{+2}}]}{[\mathrm{Ag^{+}}]^{2}}$
$1.6 = [0.8 - (-0.76)] - \frac{0.059}{2}\log\frac{1}{(\mathrm{Ag^{+}})^{2}}$
$\Rightarrow 0.04 = 0.059\log[\mathrm{Ag^{+}}]$
$\Rightarrow \log[\mathrm{Ag^{+}}] = \frac{0.04}{0.059} = \frac{4}{5.9}$

questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.stem:
Given below are two statements :
Statement I : The number of pairs among $[\mathrm{Al_2O_3, Cr_2O_3}]$, $[\mathrm{Cl_2O_7, Mn_2O_7}]$, $[\mathrm{Na_2O, V_2O_3}]$ and $[\mathrm{CO, N_2O}]$ that contain oxides of same nature (acidic, basic, neutral or amphoteric) is 4.
Statement II : Among $\mathrm{Na_2O}$, $\mathrm{Al_2O_3}$, $\mathrm{CO}$ and $\mathrm{Cl_2O_7}$, the most basic and acidic oxides are $\mathrm{Na_2O}$ and $\mathrm{Cl_2O_7}$, respectively.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
Oxides | Nature
$[\mathrm{Al_2O_3, Cr_2O_3}]$ | – Amphoteric
$[\mathrm{Cl_2O_7, Mn_2O_7}]$ | – Acidic
$[\mathrm{Na_2O, V_2O_3}]$ | – Basic
$[\mathrm{CO, N_2O}]$ | – Neutral
Most basic oxide $= \mathrm{Na_2O}$
Most acidic oxide $= \mathrm{Cl_2O_7}$

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
Statement I is true but Statement II is false.
Statement I is false but Statement II is true.

questions.stem:
Given below are two statements :
Statement I : Presence of large number of unpaired electrons in transition metal atoms results in higher enthalpies of their atomisation.
Statement II : $d_{xy} = d_{xz} = d_{yz} < d_{x^{2}-y^{2}} = d_{z^{2}}$ and $d_{x^{2}-y^{2}} = d_{z^{2}} < d_{xy} = d_{xz} = d_{yz}$ are the d-orbital splittings in $\mathrm{[Fe(H_2O)_6]^{3+}}$ and $\mathrm{[Ni(Cl)_4]^{2-}}$ complex ions respectively.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
S-I No of unpaired $e^{-} \uparrow \Rightarrow$ strength of metallic bonding $\uparrow \Rightarrow \Delta_{a}H \uparrow$
S-II $\mathrm{[Fe(H_2O)_6]^{+3}}$ – octahedral: $e_g$ ($d_{x^{2}-y^{2}}$, $d_{z^{2}}$) above $t_{2g}$ ($d_{xy}$, $d_{yz}$, $d_{zx}$)
$\mathrm{[NiCl_4]^{2-}}$ – Tetrahedral: $t_{2}$ ($d_{xy}$, $d_{yz}$, $d_{zx}$) above $e$ ($d_{x^{2}-y^{2}}$, $d_{z^{2}}$)

questions.stem:
Identify the correct statements from the following :
A. $\mathrm{[Fe(C_2O_4)_3]^{3-}}$ is the most stable complex among $\mathrm{[Fe(OH)_6]^{3-}}$, $\mathrm{[Fe(C_2O_4)_3]^{3-}}$ and $\mathrm{[Fe(SCN)_6]^{3-}}$.
B. The stability of $\mathrm{[Cu(NH_3)_4]^{2+}}$ is greater than that of $\mathrm{[Cu(en)_2]^{2+}}$.
C. The hybridization of Fe in $\mathrm{K_4[Fe(CN)_6]}$ is $d^{2}sp^{3}$.
D. $\mathrm{[Fe(NO_2)_3Cl_3]^{3-}}$ exhibits linkage isomerism.
E. $\mathrm{NO_2^{-}}$ and $\mathrm{SCN^{-}}$ ligands are NOT ambidentate ligands.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
(A) Since $\mathrm{C_2O_4^{-2}} \rightarrow$ chelating ligand so, $\mathrm{[Fe(C_2O_4)_3]^{-3}} \rightarrow$ most stable
(B) Stability : $\mathrm{[Cu(en)_2]^{+2} > [Cu(NH_3)_4]^{+2}}$
(C) $\mathrm{K_4[Fe(CN)_6]}$ – $d^{2}sp^{3}$ (octahedral)
(D) Since $\mathrm{NO_2^{-}}$ ambidentate ligand so, exhibits linkage isomerism.
(E) $\mathrm{NO_2^{-}}$ ; $\mathrm{SCN^{-}} \rightarrow$ ambidentate ligand

options.text: A, B, C, D and E

questions.stem:
$20\ \mathrm{g}$ hemoglobin in a $1\ \mathrm{L}$ aqueous solution (A) at $300\ \mathrm{K}$ is separated from pure water by semi permeable membrane. At equilibrium the height of solution in a tube dipped in a solution (A) is found to be $80.0\ \mathrm{mm}$ higher than the tube dipped in water.
The molar mass of hemoglobin is _________ $\mathrm{kg\,mol^{-1}}$. (Nearest integer)
(Given : $g = 10\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$, $R = 8.3\ \mathrm{kPa\,dm^{3}\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$, density of solution $= 1000\ \mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$)
questions.solution:
$\pi = dgh$
$= 100 \times 10 \times 0.08$
$= 800\ \mathrm{Pa} = 0.8\ \mathrm{kPa}$
Let, M.wt of Hemoglobin $= M\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$
$\pi = CRT$
$0.8\ \mathrm{kPa} = \frac{20/M}{1\mathrm{L}} \times 8.3 \times 300$
$\Rightarrow M = 62.25\ \mathrm{kg\,mol^{-1}}$

questions.stem:
At $298\ \mathrm{K}$, the molar conductivity of $x\%$ (w/w) MX solution (aqueous) is $12.35\ \mathrm{S\,cm^{2}\,mol^{-1}}$. The conductance of same solution is $1.9 \times 10^{-3}\ \mathrm{s}$. The value of x is _______ $\times 10^{-2}$.
(Given : cell constant $= 1.3\ \mathrm{cm^{-1}}$; molar mass of MX is $75\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$, density of aqueous solution of MX at $298\ \mathrm{K}$ is $1.0\ \mathrm{g\,mL^{-1}}$)
questions.solution:
$\Lambda_{m} = K \times \frac{1000}{M}$
$123.5 = (1.3 \times 1.9 \times 10^{-3}) \times \frac{1000}{M}$
$\Rightarrow M = 0.02\ \mathrm{mol\,L^{-1}}$
$\%w/w = \frac{0.02 \times 75}{1000} \times 100 = 0.15 = 15 \times 10^{-2}$

questions.stem:

The value of x in the given figure is ________ s (Nearest integer)
questions.solution:
Since, $t_{1/2} \propto [\mathrm{A}]_{0}^{1} \Rightarrow$ zero order
and $t_{1/2} \propto [\mathrm{A}]_{0}^{1-n}$
$\frac{240}{x} = \left(\frac{4 \times 10^{-3}}{1.5 \times 10^{-3}}\right)^{1-0}$
$\frac{240}{x} = 2.67$
$\Rightarrow x = 89.88 \cong \boxed{90\ \mathrm{sec}}$
